## Files in the kit

| Folder / file | What it is |
|---|---|
| `Effects/ReaScratch/reascratch.jsfx` | The scratch audio engine (JSFX plug-in) |
| `Effects/ReaScratch/reascratch_cue.jsfx` | The headphone mix (on the `Cue` track; the `Cue mix` knob blends cue and main. The metronome is added wherever the `Cue mix` knob is) |
| `Effects/ReaScratch/reascratch_perf.jsfx` | The performance lanes (`DJ performance lanes`). Setup puts it on each deck's engine track; it records what you do on the deck onto REAPER's timeline while REAPER records, and plays it back in performance playback mode (see [“Recording and playing a performance on REAPER's timeline”](scratching-from-envelopes-patterns.md#recording-and-playing-a-performance-on-reapers-timeline)) |
| `Effects/ReaScratch/reascratch_logo.png` | Title logo of the plug-in screen (keep it in the same folder as the JSFX; without it, plain text is shown) |
| The other images in `Effects/ReaScratch/` (`tex_front.png`, `knob_big.png`, `platter.png` and the other `*.png`) | Images for the plug-in screen (frame, panels, knobs, lamps, switches, TBKgao logo mark, record, help watermark). Keep them in the same folder as the JSFX. It works without them, but with a simpler look |
| `Effects/ReaScratch/LICENSE_Saike_filters.txt` | License (MIT) of the DJ filter models in the JSFX, ported from Saike's JSFX (Joep Vanlier) |
| `Effects/ReaScratch/LICENSE_ntsc_zhuker.txt` | License (Apache 2.0) of the VHS video effect, ported from zhuker's ntsc |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_setup.lua` | Initial setup: creates the tracks, loads the JSFX and registers the other scripts |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_import_video.lua` | Imports a video. Places it, extracts a WAV (with FFmpeg if available, otherwise with REAPER itself) and loads it into the JSFX. Warns you if the extracted audio goes silent from some point to the end |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_reencode_mjpeg.lua` | Re-encodes a video to all-intra (AVI/MJPEG) and swaps it in (FFmpeg if available, otherwise REAPER itself) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_video_sync.lua` | Syncs the video window to the scratch position. While it runs, it immediately stops REAPER's own play and pause (to keep the picture and sound from drifting apart; recording is not stopped). Run it again to stop it. If you answer Yes in setup, it starts automatically with REAPER |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_video_reopen.lua` | Reopens the video window (use it when the video window has frozen after a monitor or projector was switched off/on or unplugged; fullscreen is kept) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_load_test.lua` | Load test (about 40 s). Each deck scratches by itself while the script measures dropouts, JSFX load and screen stalls, and saves the result to a text file. See [“Testing on a low-spec PC (load test)”](testing-on-a-low-spec-pc-load-test.md) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_pattern.lua` | Places a scratch pattern on a deck (as envelope automation items). See [“Scratching from envelopes (patterns)”](scratching-from-envelopes-patterns.md) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_pattern_save.lua` | Saves a pattern you rearranged under a name and adds it to the pattern menu |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_record_lanes.lua` | Turns writing recorded performance movements into envelopes on or off (on by default). See [“Recording a performance into envelopes”](scratching-from-envelopes-patterns.md#recording-a-performance-into-envelopes) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_lanes.lua` | Shows or hides the envelope lanes by group (hand-made scratch, recorded effects, performance lanes). See [“Showing only the lanes you use”](scratching-from-envelopes-patterns.md#showing-only-the-lanes-you-use) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_take.lua` | Turns performance capture on/off (each deck's audio and video, and the finished mix as seen on screen). See [“Capturing a performance”](scratching-from-envelopes-patterns.md#capturing-a-performance) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_perf_play.lua` | Turns performance playback mode (`PERF PLAY` on the toolbar) on/off. While it is on, REAPER's playback plays the performance lanes back. See [“Recording and playing a performance on REAPER's timeline”](scratching-from-envelopes-patterns.md#recording-and-playing-a-performance-on-reapers-timeline) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_perf_play_decks.lua` | Chooses which decks performance playback mode plays (both, deck A only or deck B only) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_export.lua` | Write the hot cues, memory cues, CUE, BPM, beat grid and key of the decks' samples to an XML for rekordbox or to ReaScratch track data. See “Writing out track data” |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_rekordbox.lua` | Choose the XML exported from rekordbox, Traktor's `collection.nml` or VirtualDJ's `database.xml` and load its hot cues, memory cues, BPM, beat grid and key into the samples. See [“Loading cues from rekordbox”](basic-use.md#loading-cues-from-rekordbox) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_patterns.lua` | The included scratch patterns (baby, chirp, tear, flare, crab, transformer, stutter, freeze and more; not run directly) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_deck_mix.eel` | Video processor code that layers deck B's picture over deck A's. Setup installs it in the Video processor on the `video` track (no need to open it) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_lib.lua` | Shared library for the scripts (not run directly) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_browser.lua` | Loads the file chosen in the Media Explorer into a deck with the LOAD button (on controllers that have one), loads files dragged onto a deck's JSFX window, and previews with the `P` key. Called by the sync script, so not run directly. The LOAD button needs the js_ReaScriptAPI extension and the preview needs js_ReaScriptAPI and SWS; loading by dragging needs no extension |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_black.png` | A black picture placed where a sample slot is empty (emptied, or nothing loaded yet), so the video window does not keep showing the last picture. Used by the scripts |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_audio_only.avi` | The spinning speaker video placed where a sample has sound only (it turns with the record. Used by the scripts) |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_lights_off.ps1` | A small program that turns every controller light off after REAPER closes (Windows). It starts with the video sync script and waits for REAPER to close |
| `Scripts/ReaScratch/reascratch_ctl_presets.lua` | Writes and reads controller presets made on the setup screen's `Learn` tab (called by the sync script; not run directly). Saved to `Data/ReaScratch_controllers/` in the REAPER resource folder (`<controller name>.reascratch-preset`) |
| `ProjectTemplates/ReaScratch.RPP` | A project template that is already set up |
| `Data/ReaScratch/reascratch_screenset.ini` | The ReaScratch window layout (a REAPER window set). Setup adds it to REAPER's window sets when you answer Yes to "Use the ReaScratch window layout?" |
| `Data/ReaScratch_samples/` | Where the WAVs read by the JSFX are stored (the import script writes them). The `(empty).wav` marks an empty sample slot (a silent file; if you delete it, setup or import recreates it). `rs_load_a1.wav` to `rs_load_b8.wav` hold the sound loaded with the LOAD button (setup makes them), and files such as `rs_load_a1_src.txt` record which source each sound was made from |
| `tools/allintra_ffmpeg.cmd` / `.command` | Alternative standalone conversion scripts for users with FFmpeg installed |
| `HID bridge/` | A set of programs that turns NI Traktor Kontrol S2 / S3 / S4 (HID) into MIDI (contents below the table). See [“HID controllers (NI Traktor Kontrol S4, S3, S2)”](controller-setup-and-midi-mapping.md#hid-controllers-ni-traktor-kontrol-s4-s3-s2) |
| `ReaScratch_manual_en.pdf` | This manual (the full text plus screen diagrams and the preset table; searchable, copyable text, and the contents link to each chapter). `ReaScratch_manual.pdf` is the Japanese edition |
| `README.md` | A short guide with just the setup steps and troubleshooting. `README_ja.md` is the Japanese edition |
| `ReaScratch_screenshot_en.png` / `ReaScratch_screenshot.png` | An example of REAPER after setup (toolbar 3, the video window, the JSFX windows of decks A and B), with REAPER in English / Japanese |
| `LICENSE` / `CREDITS.md` | The license (GNU GPL v3.0 or later) and the credits |

**Contents of `HID bridge/`**: `hid_bridge.py`, `ReaScratch-HID-Bridge.exe` (Windows), `build_mac.command` / `run_mac.command` (macOS), `report_windows.cmd` / `report_mac.command` (a report for testers) and `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt` (licenses of the parts bundled in the exe).
